sentences.en: Management tried to appease labor by offering them a bonus.
sentences.zh: 管理层试图安抚员工，给他们提供了奖金。

sentences.en: I blew my whole bonus on shopping and travel.
sentences.zh: 我把所有的奖金都花在了购物和旅行上。

sentences.en: Productivity has fallen. Accordingly, workers' bonuses will be reduced.
sentences.zh: 生产率下降。因此，工人的奖金将会减少。

senses.zh: 奖金，红利；额外津贴，意外收获

mnemonic: 联想记忆：bon（好的）+us（我们）→发奖金啦，我们都说好！→奖金
